description: This file implements the VsockFrameProvider class, which manages camera frame data over a virtual socket connection, including starting/stopping the session, handling YUV and JPEG frames, and communication with the connection.

classes.name: VsockFrameProvider
classes.description: A class that manages camera frame data over a virtual socket connection, including starting/stopping sessions, handling frame data, and communication.

methods.name: ~VsockFrameProvider
methods.description: Destructor that stops the frame provider.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the camera session, initializes connection, and launches the read loop thread.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the camera session and joins the read thread.

methods.name: waitYUVFrame
methods.description: Waits for a YUV frame to be available within a specified timeout.

methods.name: copyYUVFrame
methods.description: Copies the latest YUV frame into the provided layout.

methods.name: copyJpegData
methods.description: Copies the cached JPEG data into the provided buffer.

methods.name: isBlob
methods.description: Checks if the given data is a PNG or JPEG blob.

methods.name: framesizeMatches
methods.description: Checks if the data size matches the expected size for given width and height.

methods.name: VsockReadLoop
methods.description: Main loop that reads messages from the connection and processes frame data.
